start: Owner on the page of a member whose monthly plan ends in 5 days; the gym has a UPI ID in Settings and a 12-month plan that saves more than ₹300

steps.action: Open the member's WhatsApp message
user_sees: A sheet "WhatsApp <member name>"
"Which message" with "Plan ending" first, then "Welcome"
Language: English, हिन्दी, Both
must_not: "Plan ended" or "Birthday wish" offered when they do not fit today

steps.action: Read the box "Message (you can change it)"
user_sees: "... your <plan> plan ends on <date>. Renew at the desk to keep training without a break."
"Or take the 12-month plan for ₹.. and save ₹.. over paying month by month."
"Pay ₹<renewal price> on UPI to <gym UPI ID>. Or tap this link to pay:" and a pay link with that exact amount
The gym's sign-off line
must_not: A price that is not the plan's price today
A saving line when the saving is under ₹300
A pay link to any UPI ID but the gym's
The word "plan" twice ("Gold plan plan")

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp"
user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab on this member's number with the words typed
must_not: A message sent without the owner pressing send in WhatsApp
Another member's number

start: Other way in: Messages & offers, the personal message "Plan ending", sent down a list

steps.action: Open Messages & offers, pick "Plan ending" and start sending
user_sees: A sheet "Plan ending · one by one" with the first member's ready words
must_not: Members with an incomplete mobile number in the list
Members whose plan does not end soon

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp", come back, tap "Next"
user_sees: The next member with their own name, date and price
must_not: The previous member's name or amount in the next message

steps.action: Tap "Skip" on one, then "Done" on the last
user_sees: The sheet closes
must_not: A skipped member marked as sent

start: Other kind: "Plan ended", for a member whose plan ended last week

steps.action: Open the member's WhatsApp message
user_sees: "Plan ended" picked
"... your <plan> plan ended on <date>. We miss you at the gym. Renew and come back any day."
The UPI line with the renewal price
must_not: "Plan ending" offered for an ended plan
An empty date

steps.action: Pick हिन्दी
user_sees: The same message in Hindi with the date in Hindi month words
must_not: English and Hindi mixed in one sentence
Hand-typed changes kept in the wrong language

start: Other kind: "Birthday wish", for a member whose birthday is today

steps.action: Open the member's WhatsApp message and pick "Birthday wish"
user_sees: "Happy birthday, <first name>! Wishing you a great year and great workouts." and the sign-off
must_not: A fee, a price or a pay link in a birthday wish
"Mr" or "Dr" used as the first name

steps.action: Pick "Both"
user_sees: English, a blank line, then Hindi, signed once at the end
must_not: Two sign-off lines

start: Other kind: "Haven’t seen you", for a member on the Away list with weeks left on the plan

steps.action: Open the member's WhatsApp message and pick "Haven’t seen you"
user_sees: "... we haven’t seen you in <n> days. All well? Your plan runs till <date>. See you soon."
must_not: Money, a price or an offer in this message
"1 days"
This choice for a member who is not on the Away list

steps.action: Do the same for a member who never checked in
user_sees: "... we haven’t seen you at the gym yet. All well? ..."
must_not: "in null days"

start: Owner; a member with a mobile number two digits short; a gym with no UPI ID; a member on a personal-training pack

steps.action: Open the WhatsApp message of the member with the short number
user_sees: "This mobile number is not complete, so WhatsApp can’t open it. Tap Edit on their page to fix it."
No "Send on WhatsApp" button
must_not: WhatsApp opened on a wrong or half number

steps.action: In a gym with no UPI ID open "Plan ending"
user_sees: The renew sentence with no UPI line and no pay link
must_not: "Pay ₹.. on UPI to ." with an empty ID
A broken link

steps.action: Open "Plan ending" for a member whose only plan is a personal-training pack
user_sees: No renewal price and no longer-plan line
must_not: A session pack priced as a monthly renewal

steps.action: Clear the whole message box and look at the send button
user_sees: unknown
must_not: An empty WhatsApp message opened with no warning (not checked in this pass)

start: Owner with the sheet open on "Plan ending" in English

steps.action: Change a few words by hand, then tap हिन्दी
user_sees: The ready Hindi words replace everything in the box
must_not: Half English, half Hindi
unknown: no question before typed words are dropped

steps.action: Close the sheet and open it for another member
user_sees: The language picked last time is still picked
must_not: The first member's words in the second member's box

steps.action: Renew the first member, then open their WhatsApp message
user_sees: "Plan ending" is gone; "Welcome" with "Your <plan> plan runs till <new date>."
must_not: The old end date
"Plan ending" still first

steps.action: Send the same message twice on one day
user_sees: WhatsApp opens both times
must_not: A claim that it was sent (the single sheet keeps no record)

start: Owner sending a fees reminder to a member who owes ₹500

steps.action: Open the member's WhatsApp message, "Fees reminder"
user_sees: "... ₹500 of your fees is due. Please pay at the front desk or on UPI." and a pay link for exactly ₹500
must_not: Another member's dues
The gym's bank details beyond the UPI ID
The amount in the link different from the amount in words

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp"
user_sees: The owner's own WhatsApp, on this member's number only
must_not: The admin app sending it itself or copying it to anyone
The message kept on the server

steps.action: Open "Haven’t seen you" for the same member
user_sees: Words about training only
must_not: The ₹500 mentioned in it

start: Front-desk sign-in on the page of a member whose plan ends today

steps.action: Open the member's WhatsApp message
user_sees: A sheet "WhatsApp <member name>" with "Plan ending" picked
must_not: The sheet refused to the desk

steps.action: Read the message
user_sees: "... your <plan> plan ends today. Renew at the desk to keep training without a break." with the renewal price and the gym's UPI line
must_not: "ends on <today's date>" instead of "today"
The plan called ended on its last day

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp"
user_sees: WhatsApp opens on this member's number
must_not: A message sent by itself

start: Other kinds from a member's page as front desk: "Plan ended" and "Birthday wish"

steps.action: Open the WhatsApp message of a member whose plan ended
user_sees: "Plan ended" with the end date and the renewal UPI line
must_not: "Plan ending" offered

steps.action: Open it for a member whose birthday is today and pick "Birthday wish"
user_sees: "Happy birthday, <first name>! ..."
must_not: Money in a birthday wish

steps.action: Pick "Both"
user_sees: English then Hindi, the UPI line once
must_not: The pay link twice

steps.action: Try to open Messages & offers to send "Plan ending" down a list
user_sees: No Messages & offers page for the desk (only Workout offer and Automatic reminders open); an old link lands on Shop
must_not: The owner-only list sender opened by the desk

steps.action: Open the WhatsApp message of a member with an incomplete number
user_sees: "This mobile number is not complete, so WhatsApp can’t open it. Tap Edit on their page to fix it."
must_not: A send button

start: Front-desk sign-in with a member's sheet open

steps.action: Pick "Fees reminder", then take the member's payment in full, then open the sheet again
user_sees: "Fees reminder" is gone from the choices
must_not: A reminder for fees already paid

steps.action: Change words by hand, switch to another message, switch back
user_sees: The ready words again
must_not: unknown: hand-typed words are dropped with no question

start: Front-desk sign-in sending a fees reminder

steps.action: Open "Fees reminder" for a member
user_sees: That one member's amount due and the gym's UPI ID
must_not: The gym's money totals
Another member's dues

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp"
user_sees: The desk person's own WhatsApp on the member's number
must_not: The admin app recording that the desk messaged the member as if the gym server sent it
